answer: Each agent stakes a unique hardware-backed key as its identity anchor, and every epoch it must solve a verifiable delay puzzle whose kernel is seeded by prior epoch randomness. Forged identities fork the chain and lose their stake, while honest nodes earn jade rewards proportional to uptime. Attackers must acquire and hold real hardware plus locked collateral per identity, making mass sybil creation costlier than the rewards any single fake node can extract.
